item.title: Henrico County Public Schools announces new chief of staff
item.description: Henrico County Public Schools has announced the division's new chief of staff.

item.title: 43-year-old man hit, killed by pickup truck while walking in Henrico
item.description: A 43-year-old man was hit and killed by a pickup truck while walking in an Henrico County intersection on Wednesday evening.

item.title: Hermitage High placed on lockdown due to report of armed person
item.description: Hermitage High School was placed on lockdown Thursday afternoon due to a report of an "armed person" in the area, according to Henrico County Police Division.

item.title: Florida man charged with 74 offenses after 13 hit-and-runs on I-95
item.description: A Florida man has been charged with over 70 offenses following 13 hit-and-run crashes on Interstate 95 earlier in February.

item.title: Person hurt, multiple families without homes after fire in Albemarle
item.description: A person is hurt and multiple families are without homes after a fire in Albemarle County on Thursday.

item.title: Richmond man found guilty of trying to traffic over 95 pounds of methamphetamine, cocaine
item.description: A Richmond man was found guilty of trying to traffic over 95 pounds of methamphetamine and cocaine.

item.title: 'Finally somebody heard us': Henrico residents react after data center company's appeal is denied
item.description: In a unanimous decision, the Henrico Board of Zoning Appeals rejected a data center company's claim that it had a vested right to build a data center complex in the Varina district. The ruling upholds a decision made in December 2025 by Henrico's Director of Planning, Joseph Emerson.

item.title: Three charged with trafficking Mexican agricultural workers into forced labor on farms in Virginia and other states
item.description: Three people are facing federal charges for allegedly trafficking Mexican agricultural workers into forced labor on a farm in Northampton County, among additional farms in other states.

item.title: 'That is not what happened': Experts push back on DHS claims about Virginia's ICE agreements
item.description: Lawmakers and experts are responding after the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) made an incorrect claim about Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) and the state's agreements with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).

item.title: CarMax Park's future uncertain as Flying Squirrels, Richmond leaders clash
item.description: The timely completion of CarMax Park may be in jeopardy due to an ongoing dispute between the Richmond Flying Squirrels and the city of Richmond.
